overview.overview: Maine's two at-large electoral votes sit well to the left of the nation, with a lean of about 7.5 points Democratic. The state's margin narrowed from 9.1 points in 2020 to 6.9 in 2024, but the forecast still expects a double-digit Democratic win here, around 12 points. With only two electoral votes at stake statewide and a large expected margin, Maine has almost no chance of deciding the election; its tipping-point odds are negligible. The main uncertainty is how far the national environment swings, since Maine's outcome will largely track the national popular vote plus its Democratic lean.
overview.watch: A much stronger-than-expected Republican national environment could compress Maine's margin toward the low end of the projected range, though a flip remains unlikely.
key_factors: Maine's consistent Democratic lean of roughly 7 points versus the nation
A narrowing but still comfortable Democratic margin, from 9.1 points in 2020 to 6.9 in 2024
Only two electoral votes, making the state nearly irrelevant to the tipping-point math
